headline: InnoVent Inaugurates N$1.6 Billion Diaz Wind Farm in Namibia
summary: The N$1.6 billion Diaz wind farm, developed by InnoVent in Tsau||Khaeb National Park near Lüderitz, was inaugurated to bolster Namibia's domestic energy supply.
why: Southern African countries are investing heavily in independent renewable infrastructure to curb power import dependency and diversify power grids.

impacts.name: Utilities
impacts.why: The commercial commissioning of the wind facility injects new clean capacity into Namibia's transmission network.
